periods.time: After the rescue team departs and before the Union emergency meeting

name.zh: 严与法米利昂协调联盟救援战略
name.en: Itsuki Coordinates Union Rescue Strategy with Vermillion

periods.location: Union Japan Branch command call with Vermillion royal command
periods.summary: Itsuki briefs the Vermillion royal family on Stella's abduction and prepares a coercive diplomatic strategy to force rapid Union support if the rescue team cannot finish the job alone.
periods.cause: Eilands likely acts for personal motives, not as a normal hostage-taker, so Stella's safety cannot wait for slow Union-League fact confirmation and multilateral procedure.
periods.process: Sirius rages at Japan, then Astrea takes over the call and grasps Itsuki's strategic purpose. Itsuki explains that many Union states will prefer caution and ceasefire, so Japan may threaten bond sales, loan non-extension, ODA termination and tax privilege withdrawal to compel immediate action. He also reveals that a small elite team has already been dispatched and that stronger reinforcements may be needed through Azure Gate if the operation stalls.
periods.outcome: Astrea apologizes for doubting Itsuki's motives, Sirius accepts the plan, and Vermillion agrees to cooperate. Before Itsuki can carry the plan further, Norman Creed arrives with Edelweiss and White Beard's nonintervention order.
periods.significance: Reveals the international constraints around Stella's rescue and Itsuki's willingness to damage Japan's diplomatic capital for both national-risk and fatherly reasons.
